items.title: Steve "Ted" Brown Interview, 1958-04-22
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] We're trying to get to talk to Ray. And he's out in Hawthorne? Hawthorne, California. [INTERVIEWEE] I'll give you the address before you go.

ctx.x: And she's writing a story, and I don't know whether it's supposed to be published pretty soon. And I think, from my understanding, they put me in the band. I said, well, I wasn't in the band when you first went up there. Well, Ray says you were in the band originally, so we put your name in the band. So we left Locanna out. So I said, no, that isn't fair. I said, Locanna was with the band when you first went up there. I had already quit. And when I came back in the field, of course, all this had been pioneered,…
But tell her, where are those fights? Where did they have them?
